$comment: Default config for crew-for-claude. Replace issueTracker, verify, and packs with values that match your project. Run /install to generate this file automatically from detected stack markers.

issueTracker.$comment_type: github | local | none. Set to 'github' and add 'repo' field (e.g. 'owner/repo') for GitHub Issues.

labels.$comment_service: Service labels are project-specific and should be added by the consumer. Examples: service:auth, service:customer-mgmt, service:accounting, etc.

docs.adrNote: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) numbering discipline: workspace-level ADRs are numbered sequentially at the workspace root (docs/adr/); per-service or per-repo ADRs live in each service's or repo's own docs/adr/ directory and use independent numbering.

packs.$comment: Activation flags per pack. A pack supplies the verify defaults, commands, and hooks for a language. 'python-fastapi' is the one real pack shipped today; java/node/go are spec-only placeholders (see packs/PACK-SPEC.md).

verify.$comment: The 2-D language x class verify map. defaults[<language>] gives the command chain for a language; byRepo.<name> pins a repo's language+class and may override individual commands. Commands are shell strings run from the repo root.
